A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Context is Key benchmark, forecasting approach and scoring rule. Their main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–E support reliable comparison, including assessment of localized inconsistencies.

before.justification: v2 reports original forecasting evaluations, context ablations, failure analyses and human/LLM assessments of context relevance (Section 5; Appendices A.4 and C).

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical studies and additionally reports evaluations of ChatTime-Base and ChatTime-Chat.

M1.justification: Direct Prompt retains the same prompt template, structured forecast outputs and constrained decoding procedure (Appendix D.1). The RCRPS components and computation are unchanged. ChatTime is an added comparator.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 71 tasks, seven real-world domains and synthetic scenarios. The supplementary unemployment-context experiments and auxiliary datasets used to train UniTime and Time-LLM are also retained.

E2.justification: v4 adds actual comparisons with ChatTime-Base and ChatTime-Chat, with and without context, in Appendix C. ChatTime was cited but not evaluated in v2. The existing comparator families remain.

E3.justification: Figure 16 changes the reported diagnostic configuration from Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct to Qwen-2.5-0.5B-Instruct, replacing an explicitly task-weighted histogram with a task-frequency display. The core five-instance, 25-forecast evaluation design, RCRPS scoring and existing training protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix C.10 replaces the Mixtral failure-distribution example with a Qwen example to examine how extreme errors affect aggregate performance. The failure-count analysis also gains ChatTime entries. The irrelevant-context experiments and successful/failed forecast galleries are retained.

E5.justification: The covariance-based standard errors, 10,000 rank simulations, one-sided paired t-tests and stated training seeds are unchanged. Revised uncertainty values and additional ChatTime rows use the existing reporting procedures.

E6.justification: Existing scores, ranks and failure counts are revised, and ChatTime adds weighted RCRPS results of 0.735 and 0.747 with context. The extended-table Direct Prompt Llama-3-70B value changes from 0.237 to 0.286, resolving disagreement with Table 1. However, v4 introduces a conflicting LLMP Qwen-2.5-0.5B no-context value: 1.515 in Table 4 versus 1.318 in Tables 3 and 5. The broad performance findings remain.

T1.justification: New Appendix E.6/Table 12 compares propriety and additive/multiplicative invariance across six scoring rules. This adds a limited formal property comparison. The RCRPS definitions, covariance derivation and independence caveat already present in Appendix E.1 remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same benchmark, RCRPS and Direct Prompt contributions. They continue to claim that essential context improves forecasting and that Direct Prompt achieves the best tested aggregate performance.

C2.justification: v4 explicitly qualifies the evaluation by noting that dataset-specific methods may improve with a corresponding training set, and expands discussion of failure mechanisms and future adaptations. Section 5.4 revises its failure examples, although Appendix C.10 still discusses Mixtral despite Figure 16 now identifying Qwen.

D1.justification: v4 identifies ChatTime checkpoints and implementation sources and replaces anonymous benchmark/code/results links with ServiceNow access instructions. It removes the dedicated LLM-critique script link and omits event timing and duration from both example traffic prompts. Existing hardware and hyperparameter disclosures are largely unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 6 adds a brief discussion of time-series reasoning citing Chow, Kong, Aksu, Potosnak and Ye. The central positioning around essential textual context is retained. ChatTime's additional publication entry represents an already cited work.

P1.justification: Edits include localized grammar and model-name corrections, expanded discussion/future work, revised author/venue notes and short new appendix subsections. The main section order and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v4 adds Table 2 summarizing existing data transformations and Table 12 comparing scoring-rule properties. Appendix tables expand for ChatTime, Figure 13 adds its timings, and Figure 16 is redrawn. Several plot labels and captions change, while most figures and the overall layout are retained.

improvement.justification: ChatTime comparisons, clearer scoring-rule properties and corrected Direct Prompt Llama entries provide useful gains. However, v4 introduces a duplicated Qwen row in Table 4, a Figure 16/text model mismatch and incomplete example prompts in Appendix D. These reporting and reproducibility regressions counter the limited improvements; the PDFs do not establish a reliably assessable net quality direction.
